questions.q:
The devastation caused in Chennai recently by Cyclone Michaung, despite early alerts and enough time to be safe and secure, is proof enough that the Tamil Nadu Government is a very slow learner, if not altogether dyslexic. Just eight years back, a similar situation was witnessed during the infamous Chennai floods but nothing to help address the residents' woes has been done since 2015. Despite early warnings predicting the cyclone's path and intensity, the State Government's lack of preparedness has resulted in widespread suffering for the coastal city. Meteorological agencies had been closely monitoring Cyclone Michaung for days, providing timely and accurate information but the Government failed to take proactive measures. All it did was to declare a public holiday in four districts when the cyclone hit the coast with unprecedented force, leaving behind a trail of destruction. One of the key areas where the Government exhibited lapses was in planning. Many vulnerable, low-lying areas were not evacuated in time; then the lack of coordination between authorities and residents led to chaotic evacuation efforts.
As the cyclone made landfall, it became evident that the relief measures and existing shelters were woefully inadequate; these were overcrowded, lacking basic amenities such as water and sanitation, besides medical aid. Power lines broke down, leading to widespread outages and disrupting communication. Roads were flooded, making it difficult for emergency services to reach the affected areas. The lack of investment in resilient infrastructure has proved to be a significant shortcoming. A city's drainage, which is the most important aspect in such situations, is still a mess with clogged sewers and overflowing wastewater drains. Another critical aspect was the delayed response in initiating rescue operations even after the cyclone made landfall and there were clear indications of stress among the residents, which cost precious lives. The toll could have been much higher had there been no early warning: Now there are modern machines and technology to correctly predict such natural calamities, the authorities need to only show the will and determination, besides acting on the information in a timely manner. The cyclone, now weaker, has moved to Andhra, but leaves behind many questions. In the aftermath of the cyclone, there is a growing call for accountability and a thorough investigation into the lapses. It is imperative that lessons are learned from this apathetic attitude to ensure better preparedness for natural disasters. Moving forward, it is crucial for authorities to prioritise investment in infrastructure, improve coordination in evacuation and relief efforts and foster a culture of preparedness to protect communities from the increasingly unpredictable forces of nature.
What is the main theme of the passage?
options: The resilience of the Chennai residents
Government's inadequate response to natural disasters
questions.solution: D)The passage primarily focuses on the government's slow learning, lack of preparedness, and inadequate response to Cyclone Michaung. It critiques the authorities' failure in various aspects such as evacuation, relief measures, and infrastructure.

In the aftermath of the cyclone, there is a growing call for accountability and a thorough investigation into the lapses. It is imperative that lessons are learned from this apathetic attitude to ensure better preparedness for natural disasters. Moving forward, it is crucial for authorities to prioritise investment in infrastructure, improve coordination in evacuation and relief efforts and foster a culture of preparedness to protect communities from the increasingly unpredictable forces of nature.
 In the passage, the word "apathetic" is used. Which of the following words is the closest in meaning to "apathetic" as used in the context of the passage?
questions.solution: B)In the passage, "apathetic" is used to describe the attitude towards disaster preparedness and response. The word "apathetic" generally means showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern. Therefore, "indifferent," which conveys a similar sense of lack of interest or concern, is the closest synonym in this context.

The victory of Geert Wilders, a far-right, anti-Islam populist, in the parliamentary elections has put the Netherlands, long seen as one of the most socially liberal countries in Europe, ______1______. According to the preliminary results, Mr. Wilders’s Party for Freedom (PVV) has emerged as the single largest party with 37 seats in the 150-member lower house. The Labour-Green coalition won 25 seats, while the ______2_____People’s Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD) secured 24. While the PVV is far from the 76 seats needed for a majority, its ______3______ performance (it won three more seats than what the VVD won in the last elections) puts Mr. Wilders in a position to start coalition talks and on a potential path towards becoming the country’s first far-right Prime Minister. Over the years, Mr. Wilders has built an image of himself as one of the most radical far-right populists in Europe. He has ______4_______ “de-Islamising” the Netherlands, shutting down mosques, banning the Koran, and closing the borders to migrants from Muslim-majority countries. He made the influx of migrants a strong political issue during the campaign, which appears to have helped him deal the greatest ______5______ the political establishment.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
questions.solution:
B) 'at a crossroads' सही है क्योंकि यह अभिव्यक्ति का प्रयोग तब होता है जब किसी देश या संगठन के सामने भविष्य के लिए महत्वपूर्ण और निर्णायक विकल्प हों। यहाँ, नीदरलैंड्स के लिए यह एक महत्वपूर्ण मोड़ है क्योंकि वे एक नए राजनीतिक युग में प्रवेश कर रहे हैं। 'At a certain' का अर्थ होता है एक निश्चित स्थिति में, जो यहां प्रासंगिक नहीं है। 'At a low' का अर्थ होता है एक निम्न स्तर पर, जो इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं है। 'Course to take' इस संदर्भ में असंगत है क्योंकि यह एक विशिष्ट दिशा या पाठ्यक्रम की ओर संकेत नहीं करता।
'at a crossroads' is correct as it is used to denote a situation where a country or organization faces significant and decisive choices for the future. Here, the Netherlands is at a crucial juncture as they are entering a new political era. 'At a certain' means in a specific situation, which is not relevant here. 'At a low' implies being at a low level, which is not appropriate in this context. 'Course to take' is irrelevant here as it does not indicate a specific direction or course of action.

questions.solution:

In this context, the word 'Incumbent' should be used. 'Incumbent' means currently holding office or existing. Here, it refers to the People's Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD), which is already in power, making 'Incumbent' appropriate. 'Discernment' means the ability to judge well, 'Intimidate' means to frighten, and 'Prevent' means to stop, which do not fit in this context.

questions.solution:
A) called for'होगा क्योंकि "called for" का अर्थ होता है किसी चीज की मांग करना या उसे जरूरी बताना। वाक्य में बताया गया है कि मिस्टर वाइल्डर्स ने नीदरलैंड्स को "डी-इस्लामाइज़" करने की बात कही है, जो उनकी एक मांग या आवश्यकता के रूप में प्रस्तुत की गई है। वहीं, 'B. struggle for' का अर्थ होता है किसी चीज के लिए संघर्ष करना, 'C. concern for' का अर्थ है किसी चीज के लिए चिंतित होना, और 'D. search for' का अर्थ है किसी चीज की खोज करना, जो इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।

The sentence indicates that Mr. Wilders has advocated "de-Islamising" the Netherlands, presenting it as a demand or requirement. In contrast, 'B. struggle for' implies fighting for something, 'C. concern for' means being worried about something, and 'D. search for' means looking for something, which are not suitable in this context.
